family.description: This is a beta-propeller domain found in Prolow-density lipoprotein receptor-related protein 1 (LRP1) from human, an endocytic receptor involved in endocytosis and in phagocytosis of apoptotic cells [[cite:PUB00151931],[cite:PUB00151932]]. LRP1 is involved in cellular lipid homeostasis and in the plasma clearance of chylomicron remnants and activated LRPAP1 (alpha 2-macroglobulin), as well as the local metabolism of complexes between plasminogen activators and their endogenous inhibitors. It acts as an LRPAP1 alpha-2-macroglobulin receptor [[cite:PUB00151934],[cite:PUB00151933]].
family.name: LRP1, beta-propeller domain
